course: Even though this course is really interesting, it is really hard course in terms of both understanding and workload. The course consists of many different subjects which is interesting but hard. Neither classnotes nor readings can help for assignments most of the time.

Topics were extremely interesting. I also enjoyed most of our homework. However, homework can be very difficult and many students might feel they are overwhelmed by homework. Also, if you are not prepared, you will feel that the class is very difficult. You should work regularly!

1. Overall content of the course was really exciting to think about and work on. Articles were great and the weekly structure of the content made sense. But I think that the last part regarding Gödel's incompleteness theorems would merit more scrutiny to understand the real importance of the core ideas. I understand that this would require another course merely on these theorems, but it seems to me that it would be better in this case to leave these theorems out of this course's content since a couple of hours are simply not enough to "understand" anything important about them.

2. Assignments were fun, intriguing, and challenging, but they were a bit too much since they were weekly and often required more than a couple hours to solve entirely. 

3. I think it was also problematic that some questions in the assignments required a direct answer that would turn out to be either directly false or true. It would make more sense to me if they were required more philosophical interpretation about the deeper problems and less mechanical display of understanding specific examples, concepts, theories. 

However, in general, the course was very informative and very useful, particularly for philosophy students.
The homework assignments could've been less/ easier.

Strongest::: He explains everything from the very basic and spoon-feeds students every topic. The homework questions are so organized that even if you never studied the topics or attended the class before, you can solve them from the beginning cause they are full of hints and built upon one another.  The most important thing that he provides students is his youtube video lectures. I hope he continues this tradition in next batch also cause even though some students might prefer face-to-face lectures at first (like me), youtube video lectures are the best to watch, rewatch and learn. 
Weakest::: He gives too much break time and we lost time of discussion due to these breaks. For example, between lectures he gives 15 minutes of breaks instead of the usual 10 minutes. He also ends his class 5-10 minutes before due to some of us having lectures just after the class and we need to prepare for the next class. These reduced our discussion time. O kadar mükemmel bir hoca ki. Ders anlatması, bize karşı olan tavrı, her zaman güler yüzlü olması, her şeyiyle mükemmel bir hoca bence. Derse girince pozitif hissettiğim hocalardan bir tanesi. Bize çok şey kattı, biraz sıkıcı ve zor bir ders olmasına rağmen ben çok keyif aldım dönem boyunca.

So much to learn from him, I would like to have a conversation.

Hocamız süreç boyunca sınıfa karşı olan tutumuyla işini çok sevdiğini bize hissettirdi. Bu derste öğrendiğimiz her şeyin günlük hayatımızda yeri olduğuna inanmış olarak süreci değerlendirdiğimi düşünüyorum. Hocamız süreç boyunca dersin içeriklerini bize aktarma konusunda elinden geleni yaptı ve içerisinde olduğumuz pandemi ve çevrimiçi eğitim şartlarını anlayışla karşılayarak ders içeriklerini bizlere kaliteli ve faydalı biçimde aktardı. Thank You Nick.
Dersi cidden sevdiriyor ve çok anlayışlı bir öğretim elemanı. Kesinlikle çok saygılı ve konular hakkında çok bilgili.
course: Ders çok uğraştırıcı ve yorucu bir ders. Bazen çok zaman gerektiren sorumlulukları olabiliyor.
Çok iş yükü var ama Nick dersin bir kısmını youtube a yükleyerek ve ödevlerin ağırlığını arttırarak bize yardımcı oldu. Gönderdiği detaylı ve açıklayıcı slaytlar olmasa bu dönemi halledemezdik.
This class never bored me because the only thing we had to do was thinking.

Bence ders harika. İnsana bir çok şey öğretiyor ve farklı bakış açıları katıyor. Ama çok fazla yapılacak şey veriliyor. Yani aslında tam olarak öğrenince çok iyi kavrayacağım bir konuyu, sürekli art arda ödev verildiği için doğru düzgün kavrayamıyorum ve karışıyor. O bakımdan biraz zordu.
6 kredi çok fazla. Hukuk derslerinden çok bu derse çalıştım ve emeğimin karşılığını aldım mı onu bile bilmiyorum. Kredi sayısı azaltılmalı ya da İngilizce kısmı çıkartılmalı

instructor: I really liked the way he taught us a lot of different perspectives in philosophy so effective and fun. I was really relaxed and open in the classes, he provided us such an atmosphere that almost everybody participated and actually learned a lot of things. He is great. Thanks!

He is the best instructor in Bilkent. I was struggling with assignments of other courses so I could not upload few homeworks of this course. With his help, now I am able to pass this course, this is the 3rd time I am taking this course. If you show your effort in the course, he will do everything he can. Without his help I would hate this course. Thank you for everything Sir.

I think Nich is one of the best philosophers in the Bilkent and the world right now, he does care about the students' thoughts and ideas a lot. I feel quite lucky to take phil 243 from him, he improved the way how I think and write about anything. Homeworks, class discussions and term-paper were requiring analytical thinking. His grading is reasonable and forces us to think deeper like a philosopher. I hope that I can take phil 244 from him too. Thanks for everything hocam!

Nicholas Di Bella is a brilliant instructor, he always supported us to give our opinion, he never judged anyone for their opinion, I think in phil courses, instructor should create an enviroment where students express their opinions without any hesitation. As far as I observe from my class, everyone could express themselves explicitly. He tried to teach us "how to think" at the begining of the course, it was not boring reading course. I enjoyed from the homeworks that he gave us because these homeworks make me to think and evaluate the facts, it was not just a basic essay homeworks.
course: I think this class is beneficial for us to expand our ideas and analytical thinking, I liked the course very much.
In such a pandemic times, reading something related with justice, happiness, virtue or morality make me looking to the situations differently. I am thinking to take additional phil courses.

Ders niye 6 kredi ve 2 ayrı öğretim elemanı tarafından veriliyor. Eğer bu ders felsefeyle alakalıysa sadece felsefe hocası versin, ingilizce hocasının bu derste ne işi var. Zaten bu dersi alan insanlar felsefe kısmında zorlanması gerekirken ingilizce kısmında zorlanıyor. Zaten hazırlık üstüne 2 kere ingilizce dersi de bölümde alıyoruz. Üstüne curriculumda neden var olduğunu bilmediğimiz bir derste de alakasız bir şekilde ingilizce kısmı var. İngilizce hocaları bile niye bu course da olduklarını bilmiyor.
assistant: There is no support staff. However i really think that english section with an English teacher is so unnecessary for this course. Students have already done more than enough analysis and review on texts, English section does nothing but repeats everything we have already done. It is only a burden of time in this respect.
